target_customer: International travelers from card-centric markets spending in QR-wallet countries
problem: Travelers cannot easily pay local QR wallets without a local bank account, so they rely on cash, ATMs and card fees.
business_model: Consumer payments app with a 1.5% fee per payment (company website)

founders.name: Walid Mahd
founders.background_notes: Card and fintech payments consultant per YC page.

founders.name: Sam Yu
founders.background_notes: Head of R&D at Stems; internships at the other companies per YC page.

competitors.name: Alipay+
competitors.what: Cross-border QR acceptance and wallet interoperability for travelers
competitors.traction_then: Transactions tripled in the first nine months of 2024; over 30 payment partners, 90 million merchants, 66 markets by October 2024

technical_complexity.rationale: Connecting to many local QR networks and meeting money transmission rules is integration heavy but not research grade.

defensibility.rationale: Local network integrations and licenses take effort, but wallets and card issuers can add the same corridors.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Alipay+ expanded traveler QR acceptance in 2024; no source shows incumbents acquiring or killing Moreta.

market_need_then: QR wallets were becoming dominant at checkout across Asia while foreign cards were often unaccepted; YC page cites 200 million arriving travelers a year (company claim).

branding.domain_note: Website is moretapay.com, a pay suffix, rather than moreta.com.

identity.logo: White wordmark used on dark backgrounds
identity.visual_style: Phone mockups and country flag icons
identity.voice_and_tone: Plain, friendly and direct, with benefit-led headlines such as 'Pay like a local via QR codes'

branding.community_and_virality: Website shows traveler testimonials and influencer videos plus store ratings (Trustpilot 4.6, Google Play 4.8, App Store 4.2), all company-presented.

brand_strength.rationale: Clear, travel-friendly message and social proof on the site, but little independent press about the brand and no sourced name origin.

outcome_analysis: Moreta is an active Summer 2024 company that has launched in about 15 countries and reports 250,000 users and $70 million in processed volume in a September 2026 press release, which is company-reported. Funding disclosure is thin, so the traction cannot be compared with capital raised; the main risks are Alipay+ style incumbents and licensing across many countries.
notes: Funding seen only on aggregators and unverified: VCBacked lists $500K pre-seed, CB Insights a $0.5M convertible note dated 2024-01-01 with YC as sole investor, Dealroom a $125K seed entry. Not recorded as rounds. Usage figures come from a company press release. Search found no outcome events (no shutdown, acquisition or layoffs). Name origin not found. Completeness pass: the one $500K round (YC as sole investor per CB Insights) is now recorded in rounds, resting on a single database; date left null because CB Insights says 2024-01-01 convertible note while VCBacked and Extruct say pre-seed in September 2024. Dealroom $125K seed entry remains unrecorded.
